relationships.subject: Sigma-1 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Growing evidence links the sigma-1 receptor to the regulation of autophagy, a critical process in cancer development.

relationships.subject: Haloperidol
relationships.evidence_quote: Several neuroactive drugs, including haloperidol, rimcazole, fluoxetine, and donepezil, act as sigma receptor ligands and may offer anticancer benefits.

key_findings: Sigma receptor ligand neuroactive drugs may be repurposed for CNS cancers
Sigma-1 receptor is linked to autophagy regulation
